basis: GameStop’s fiscal Q3 2022 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated statements of operations report GAAP net sales of $1,186.4 million for the 13 weeks ended October 29, 2022, against $1,296.6 million for the 13 weeks ended October 30, 2021. Sales fell 8.50% year over year and were $45.37 million below the $1,231.77 million cutoff. The earlier earnings cycles, intervening announcements, and searches for preliminary results, investor presentations and public management remarks yielded no earlier quarter-specific sales bound.

coverage.detail: GameStop’s original fiscal Q3 2021 release reports consolidated net sales of $1,296.6 million, matching the comparative figure in the fiscal Q3 2022 release.
June 1, 2022. The Q1 release reported $1.378 billion in Q1 sales. Its forward-looking timing concerned the planned Q2 NFT marketplace launch. It gave no Q3 sales forecast.
June 1, 2022. On GameStop’s Q1 earnings call, CEO Matt Furlong said the company was providing no formal guidance. He gave no numeric Q3 sales outlook.
September 7, 2022. The immediately preceding release reported $1.136 billion in sales for Q2 ended July 30, against $1.183 billion a year earlier. It gave no Q3 revenue range.
September 7, 2022. On the Q2 earnings call, Furlong said GameStop was providing no formal guidance. His discussion of profitability and cost control supplied no Q3 sales bound.
September 7, 2022. The separate FTX announcement described a U.S. retail partnership and gave no consolidated sales outlook.
October 31, 2022. Two days after quarter end, GameStop announced its ImmutableX marketplace launch. The release discussed gaming assets and customer reach and gave no preliminary Q3 sales figure.
November 20, 2022. The publisher’s page for Chairman Ryan Cohen’s interview identifies its order-number sales model as GMEdd’s own research. It supplies no issuer estimate of Q3 net sales.
November 28, 2022. GameStop scheduled the Q3 results for after market close on December 7. The notice contained no sales figure or range.
December 7, 2022. EDGAR records acceptance of the results 8-K at 16:09:16 and lists the earnings release as Exhibit 99.1.

publication_date_evidence: GameStop’s earnings release says it released fiscal Q3 results that day and identifies December 7, 2022 as the date of its same-day results call. The November 28 issuer notice and the December 7 EDGAR acceptance independently corroborate the release date.
